properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of the @arkecosystem platform SDKs (hash.js@1.1.3); ships SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 implementations in the bundle. No direct import in application source — reachable through SDK code paths.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.1.9-1 is a transitive dependency of the platform SDKs and ships an MD5 implementation in the bundle. No direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 via crypto-js@3.1.9-1, transitive dependency of the platform SDKs. No direct import in application source; the app's own SHA-1 use is the password-pwnd HIBP k-anonymity check.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA/X.509 machinery available in the shipped tree but only used by dev-tooling self-signed certificates (webpack-dev-server 3.x local HTTPS). The production SDK path (platform-sdk-crypto -> node-forge ^0.10.0) resolves a second, separate node-forge entry. No production call site found in the application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature availability in the tree; the live chain-signing deployments (LSK, EGLD, Polkadot) use the newer tweetnacl@1.0.3, reported as separate findings. Migration path ML-DSA-65; the 0.14.5 copies ride dev/http-signature tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 provides fast ECDSA on secp256k1/secp256r1 etc. and backs the per-coin SDK signing paths this app drives through platform-sdk wrappers (message().sign/verify, transaction().signX). No direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic serves ECDSA secp256k1 signing (EOS transactions, NEO keys, TRON) and ECDH; quantum-unsafe (Shor). The ECDSA-use is also captured by shard 1's ECDSA object; this object records the ECDH/key-agreement capability of the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 availability in the same tweetnacl deployment; live usage of Curve25519 DH is in the LSK path (ed2curve converting Ed25519 keys, nacl.box), reported separately. Migration: X25519+ML-KEM-768 hybrid.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two distinct AES deployments in the shipped tree: crypto-js@3.1.9-1 encrypts NANO seeds (nanocurrency-web), crypto-js@3.3.0 encrypts NEO keys (neon-core). AES itself is quantum-safe (Grover only halves key bits); the crypto-js 3.x lineage is ancient and unpatched, which matters more than PQ here. A separate Ethereum-keystore AES instance (aes-js) is reported as a finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt KDF for keystore encryption (Ethereum JSON keystore via @ethersproject/json-wallets; NEO via neon-core). Memory-hard, quantum-safe; a second scrypt implementation (scryptsy, via bip38/elrond/polkadot) is reported as a separate finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Authenticated symmetric encryption available via the tweetnacl deployment; the live secretbox usage is in LSK message encryption (lisk-cryptography + ed2curve + tweetnacl@1.0.3), reported separately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-only self-signed certificate generation for the local HTTPS dev server; not shipped to users and not changeable in production — presence still belongs in the inventory as the dev toolchain's PKI practice.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 support in the shipped tree: production via node-forge@^0.10.0 (platform-sdk-crypto), dev via node-forge@0.9.0 (selfsigned/webpack-dev-server). No certificate files committed in the repo and no app-side TLS pinning found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT signing support via jsonwebtoken/jws/jwa, transitive dependencies (dev/test toolchain via SDKs). No signing call site in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWS (jws) transitive dependency alongside jsonwebtoken. No app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWA (jwa) transitive dependency — JWS algorithm registry (HS256/RS256 etc.). No app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is the primary live signing/encryption primitive of the LSK (Ed25519 signatures, nacl box), EGLD and Polkadot SDK paths (tweetnacl@1.0.3) — all Shor-vulnerable signature/DH. The 0.14.5 deployment rides sshpk/ed2curve tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 3.x is a 2016-era, unmaintained branch of crypto-js with known CVEs (e.g. CVE-2023-36632 padding-oracle guidance) — age, not quantum, is the primary risk; flagged for the CBOM as the shipped AES/hashing implementation for NANO and NEO wallet secrets.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWA is the algorithm-selector layer of the tronweb JWT auth stack — HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) by default; quantum-unsafe only in the sense that HMAC key sizes halve under Grover. Migration: HS512 or move TRON API auth to a PQ MAC when available.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js transitive dependency of the platform SDKs; ships the scrypt KDF. No direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js transitive dependency; ships streaming SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 implementations. No direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TRON's API layer signs JWTs (HS256 HMAC-SHA256 by default) for TronGrid-style auth tokens — quantum-unsafe MAC under harvest-now-decrypt-later only if the shared secret is recoverable; priority is low but the asset is real: it is the JWT signing dependency of the TRON integration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: md5 npm package, transitive dependency — an MD5 implementation distinct from crypto-js's. No direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcryptjs transitive dependency supplying bcrypt password hashing to SDK code paths; the app exercises Bcrypt through the platform-sdk-crypto wrapper.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jws is the JWS serialization layer between tronweb's jsonwebtoken and jwa; records the same JWT signing chain from the library side.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 transitive dependency of the platform SDKs; the ECDSA backend for the secp256k1 chains this wallet signs on. No direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: selfsigned generates self-signed X.509 certificates; toolchain/dev dependency, no call site in application source. Records that a cert-generation capability exists in the dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js transitive dependency of the platform SDKs; ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations. No direct import in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2 npm package — the backend for @arkecosystem/platform-sdk-crypto's PBKDF2 wrapper used for profile/WIF password encryption in the SDK.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge ships in the tree twice: 0.9.0 for dev self-signed certs, ^0.10.0 in the production crypto SDK (platform-sdk-crypto uses forge for X.509/PBKDF2/AES/RC4-capable primitives). 0.10.0 is also subject to CVE-2022-24773-style path issues — the version, not just the primitive, is inventory-relevant.
